CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_event(p_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (select auth.uid()) is not null
    and private.event_access_role_for_actor(p_event_id, (select auth.uid())) is not null
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.populate_event_categories()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  subcat_record RECORD;
BEGIN
  -- Solo se evento ha event_type valorizzato
  IF NEW.event_type IS NOT NULL THEN
    -- Copia tutte le subcategories per questo tipo evento
    FOR subcat_record IN
      SELECT s.id, s.default_budget
      FROM public.subcategories s
      JOIN public.categories c ON c.id = s.category_id
      JOIN public.event_types et ON et.id = c.event_type_id
      WHERE et.code = NEW.event_type
    LOOP
      INSERT INTO public.event_category_selection (
        event_id,
        subcategory_id,
        budget,
        is_selected
      ) VALUES (
        NEW.id,
        subcat_record.id,
        COALESCE(subcat_record.default_budget, 0),
        true -- Di default tutte selezionate
      )
      ON CONFLICT (event_id, subcategory_id) DO NOTHING; -- Evita duplicati
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.read_family_baptism(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from public.events where id=p_id and owner_id=auth.uid() and event_type='baptism') then raise exception 'EVENT_UNAVAILABLE'; end if;
 select jsonb_build_object('event_id',p_id,'revision',revision,'plan',plan || jsonb_build_object(
 'guests',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'name',g.name,'ceremony',case when not coalesce(g.rsvp_received,false) then 'pending' when g.attending then 'yes' else 'no' end,'menu',coalesce(g.menu_preferences[1],'pending'),'food',g.allergies_intolerances) || g.baptism_details order by g.created_at,g.id) from public.guests g where g.event_id=p_id and g.baptism_details is not null),'[]'::jsonb),
 'costs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'name',e.description,'enabled',e.is_enabled,'payments',coalesce(e.payment_installments,'[]'::jsonb)) || e.baptism_details order by e.inserted_at,e.id) from public.expenses e where e.event_id=p_id and e.baptism_details is not null),'[]'::jsonb))) into result from public.baptism_family_plans where event_id=p_id;
 return result;
end $function$
